name: PostgreSQL
description: PostgreSQL schema design, parameterized queries, transactional zero-downtime migrations, connection pooling, and Docker/Cloud SQL parity.
verification_commands: pg_isready -d "${DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://127.0.0.1:5432/{{PROJECT_SLUG}}}"  # verify PostgreSQL readiness before running migrations or integration tests
psql "${DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://127.0.0.1:5432/{{PROJECT_SLUG}}}" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "SELECT 1;"  # verify database connectivity and SQL execution

evaluators.name: PostgreSQL Data, Query Safety & Migration Evaluator
evaluators.scope: Normalized schema and index design, strictly parameterized queries, transactional zero-downtime expand/contract migrations, bounded connection pooling, and Docker/Cloud SQL parity.

single_concurrency_locks: Local PostgreSQL Instance: Only 1 subagent at a time may run migrations, schema resets, or stateful DB integration tests against a shared local container/port `5432`.
pr_checklist: All SQL queries use bound parameters (zero string interpolation), bounded `LIMIT`/keyset pagination, and connection pooling
Schema migrations are transactional/idempotent, zero-downtime safe (expand-and-contract, `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY` where required), and preserve rollback safety
agents_md_rules: **PostgreSQL Data & Migrations:** Follow [`.agents/skills/data-postgres/SKILL.md`](.agents/skills/data-postgres/SKILL.md) (parameterized queries only, zero-downtime expand/contract migrations, pooled connections, Docker/Cloud SQL parity).
